listing.aiSummary: Adds a collection of negative, positive, and golden rules, milestones, and backgrounds to the game.

description: Provides various rules and challenges for use with Unofficial New Game Plus. It includes multiple negative, positive, and golden rules, as well as milestones and a background.
descriptionHtml: Provides various rules and challenges for use with Unofficial New Game Plus. It includes multiple negative, positive, and golden rules, as well as milestones and a background.
discordPostHtml:
Collection of various rules and challenges for Unofficial New Game Plus by Originem.

Adds 16 negative, 5 positive, 1 golden negative, 1 golden positive, 5 milestones and 1 golden milestone rules as well as 1 background.

If anyone finds a bug or a crash, or just has any feedback, feel free to ping me (actually I oblige you to).

Forum post: Maybe someday later
GitHub: https://github.com/DemonX3/URB
Direct download: https://github.com/DemonX3/URB/releases/download/1.3.0/URB_v1.3.0.zip
Requires UNGP and MagicLib

v1.3.0 as of 18.08.2024
Content:
- Added 3 negative rules.
- Added 1 background.

Changes:
- Version shifted to Starsector 0.97
- 'Antagonizm':
 - Moved blacklist check up in priority.
 - Added 'Stored Frigate' hullmod from 'Indies Expansion' (or 'Aerial Combat Suite', whatever) to the blacklist.
- Moved 'Thin Insulator' rule to combat layer.
- Temporarily disabled visual range circle of 'Doomslayer', it still works.
